stepBody: Sammie wants to find the optimal solution for $$\theta_0$$ with respect to the objective function below.\n$$L(\theta_0, \theta_1) $$=$$ \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}\left(y_i $$-$$ \left(\frac{\theta_0}{4\theta_1} $$-$$ $$\theta_1$$ x_i\right)\right)**{2}$$\nFind the value of $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes $$L(\theta_0, \theta_1)$$.
